description: Retrievable notes about Henry's past openings, audience and the local card-shop landscape. Served per creator via the MCP retrieve_creator_memory tool.

documents.title: SGD 200 vintage box — I lost money and said so
documents.notes: Best performer to date. Showing the loss beat every hype video he has made. Comments repeatedly asked which shop he bought from.

documents.title: Charizard grading reveal — 9 or 10?
documents.notes: Strong. The pause before the reveal held retention to 64%. Audience asked for a full submission walkthrough.

documents.title: Beginner deck building part 1
documents.notes: Weak. Watch time collapsed at 40 seconds. Parts 2 and 3 were never filmed.

documents.title: Price checking my binder live
documents.notes: Good. Reaction to a card being worth less than expected drove the comment section.

documents.title: Who actually watches
documents.notes: 18–30, mostly SG and MY, deciding whether to spend on sealed product. They save 'is it worth it' verdicts and skip pure hype. Strong distrust of creators who quote pull rates.

documents.title: Comment patterns
documents.notes: Two recurring asks: 'which shop' and 'what would you have paid'. Both are unanswered content slots.

documents.title: Orchard Card Bar
documents.notes: Weekend queue, active Instagram of static shelf photos, no video. Owner has replied to comments before. Highest-fit sponsor target.

documents.title: GradeHouse Asia
documents.notes: New grading service. Needs trust-building content more than reach. Would suit an educational walkthrough rather than a sponsored break.

documents.title: What Henry will not do
documents.notes: No made-up pull rates, no fake reaction edits, no 'guaranteed hit' language, no loot-box giveaways aimed at under-18s. Budget is SGD 120 a week and he films Wed/Fri/Sun.
